headline: The radio ties the cook
lede: Short Order Shout's walkie-talkie stopped being a side channel: keying the mic now takes your hands off the line, and every real shout gets an answer from the CPU crew. Proven at 61 gates.

notes.text: SHORT ORDER SHOUT ships the radio law — while your take is held or draining, A/B are refused with a red-blinking mic chip and a HANDS ON RADIO toast; feet keep walking. Landed takes earn COPY chips from every CPU cook, offline and online. Engine hashes untouched — the gate lives at input origin.

Harness law learned the hard way: determinism drills latch the contract and freeze the live loop, so any browser drill that needs feet must boot fresh and wait for ticks. Confirmed-move nudges replaced fixed-sleep walks — same law the CPU emitters already obey.

soscheck 47 to 61 gates; neutering the gate turns exactly the two law gates red. A pre-existing sosplay cold-start flake was pinned against pristine main so it stops masquerading as a regression. Both other lanes shipped mid-session: CivV's per-city Ark yards and PPM's recognition chime.
